title: Foundry Raises $100M to Expand AI Driven Robotics Production
summary:
A California based firm specializing in the automation of hardware factories has secured a capital injection from lead investor Marlinspike to expand its robotics services. Foundry, which utilizes physical AI to power the construction of automated plants, raised $100 million in a Series A round that included participation from Khosla Ventures.

The funding supports the launch of a 130,000 square foot facility in Emeryville, California. The startup is already shipping products to paying customers in the autonomous vehicle, defense, energy and telecom sectors, stating that the new site will help strengthen the domestic production of critical hardware components.

Today, @FoundryRobotics is announcing our $100M Series A, led by @MarlinspikeVC with continued support from @khoslaventures.

We’re already shipping to paying customers across energy, telecom, autonomous vehicles, and defense. The next era of American manufacturing starts here.

Time to build.
